# Icon sources

- `az_*.svg`: Microsoft Azure architecture icons, from the draw.io `img/lib/azure2` library (jgraph/drawio). Use is subject to Microsoft's Azure architecture icon terms (for architecture diagrams).
- `opentelemetry`, `dotnet`, `docker`, `clickhouse`, `terraform`, `postgresql`, `ubuntu`: [simple-icons](https://simpleicons.org) 13.21.0 (CC0); trademarks belong to their owners.
- `signoz.svg`: SigNoz brand mark from the SigNoz repository; trademark of SigNoz.
